raw_model_deviations.claim_in_article: Oil prices did not fall across the whole market after the plan was withdrawn.
raw_model_deviations.issue: The sentence extends the observed movement in Brent futures to the oil market as a whole; the Ledger verifies only the Brent futures response here.
raw_model_deviations.explanation: The Ledger describes a temporary narrowing and recovery in Brent futures, not a market-wide observation. This is a scope expansion; the corresponding broad-market claim is already present in the Japanese source.
same_fact_id_locations: The Fee Plan Leaves, But High Oil Prices Stay
But they soon returned to a high level near their earlier level.
At the time of reporting, they were up about 2.6 percent, above 85 dollars a barrel.
Oil prices moved briefly, then returned to a high level.
The fee plan vanished, but oil prices stayed high as tensions around the Strait of Hormuz continued.
